planned_atomic_boundary.question: Do authoritative GitHub REST semantics expose any server-side idempotency key, immutable request-result identity, or conditional-create primitive for the allowed unprotected repository write transport that is sufficient to reconcile an ambiguous create response without relying on retained mutable repository history, protected rules, richer-mode execution, paid/finite quota, or user execution?
planned_atomic_boundary.method: Read only authoritative public GitHub documentation for the Git database/contents write surfaces relevant to this exact question; preserve exact scope and fail closed if semantics are absent or insufficient.
planned_atomic_boundary.positive_gate: A documented transport primitive must deterministically distinguish a never-applied create from an applied-but-ambiguous create after arbitrary client uncertainty, without protected retention assumptions or external execution.
planned_atomic_boundary.negative_gate: If the allowed transport provides only path/SHA checks, optimistic concurrency for updates, or client-generated commit metadata without a server-side idempotency/request identity guarantee, ambiguous-create reconciliation remains unresolved.
